body:
An Elusive Experience
Context/Intent: This trip was experienced before, and during, my good friend's birthday party. We intended to kick back and chill on a rather nonserious psychedelic, setting a positive precedent for the evening. We also decided to heavily include nitrous in the experience, to potentiate the 2CB and wax over any somatic discomfort or anxiety. I intended to settle back into tripping with friends, as Id recently been tripping entirely solo. I also wanted to focus on taking notes during the experience, to keep myself occupied and feel purposeful (quotation marks will signal raw transcriptions of my notes).
Chronology
0:00 - Dropped 26mg 2CB
0:27 - CNS Activation." This is a term I use often when I take drugs, similar to a plus/minus on the Shulgin rating scale. There is a general enhancement of sensory perception and thought acceleration, but the flavor of the experience is not defined. Had I not known I was on drugs, I would attribute the state to high anxiety, or the rush of a hard workout.
0:31 - Inhaled balloon, noneventful. We used nitrous not only for recreational purposes but also to test the level of activity of the 2CB on the come-up. If the effects of the balloons were more intense, we could assume the 2CB was rising. We also used the balloons as a way to deal with come-up anxiety/any bodily discomfort.
0:52 - Another balloon, bigger this time. Nostalgic reminiscing (signaling increased effects), still not full-blown psychedelic. There are generally two separate genres of psychedelically synergized nitrous experience. The first experience is largely anxiolytic and euphoric, featuring strong positive affirmations and a positive, nostalgic view of the past and the people that belong to it (even if these thoughts quickly dissipate following the experience). The second experience is simply a whiteout, an obliteration of self-concept and semantic network; this largely only occurs on higher doses of entheogens (ie LSD, psilocybin). As predicted, 2CB only manifested the first type of experience; I have never experienced a whiteout state. In my opinion, I believe this is because while 2CB is a psychedelic, it is not an entheogen capable of producing consistent transpersonal states at doses of 26mg (my highest dose) and below.
1:06 - Thoughts speeding up I Felt as if I was on a stimulant, with no majorly defined character and hardly any visuals.
1:22 - Definitive Activation A bit disappointing, On my previous trip on 25mg, I had felt immersed in an encompassing watercolor visual (different batch, however). 2CB seems to have largely inconsistent visual activity. My friend and I had been doing a large balloon of nitrous each at fifteen-minute intervals. They were awesome little blips, we would queue a music video and inhale at our favorite moments of each song. In many ways, the nitrous took most of the personality of the experience, 2CB largely being used as a potentiator (speaking to its subtlety).
1:54 - Feel more at peace with myself Ive had a tumultuous few months. Moving multiple time states to a place where I knew few people, struggling to reach financial stability; its left me feeling jagged. However, Ive stabilized, and this trip reinforced my overall sense of well-being.
2:32 - Some financial worries but the balloons are centering me Despite the previous paragraph, Im not totally out of the woods financially. I had several pending responsibilities I would have to tend to in the following months, and the thought of budgeting them came abruptly, and felt as thorny as you would expect. However, I was able to largely discard the feeling with a couple of balloons; like dislodging a piece of debris.
3:28 - Mild entactogenic effect, largely coming down Walked around my friend's neighborhood
to shake off any leftover energy. We decided to walk down an alleyway and were promptly barked at by a hulking pitbull, which was unpleasant despite it being fenced. Later, we saw what appeared to look like a drug deal, which was pretty comedic to experience live.
3:36 - Dose 1.5ml BDO. Id dosed BDO the following night and was interested in trying more. I knew that it was a dangerous substance to be cavalier with, so Id been taking sub-perceptual doses, and incrementing up at .25 ml. [Reported Dose of BDO: 3.25 ml cumulative] This was the first time I noticeably felt BDO, and it was quite pleasant. A more coherent, sedative gabaergic that left little residual ick.
4:59 - Dose .33 gram PEA. Noted minor intoxication from BDO
5:51 - Not sure how active PEA is, maybe some enhanced euphoria in synergy with cannabis Not sure how to describe this, but theres a certain feeling I get when I combine psychedelics and cannabis; a racey, tingling feeling. I mildly felt this after dosing .33 grams of phenthylamine, a substance known to be active only momentarily, and at higher doses. I later dosed .5 grams and felt a similar feeling.
[Reported Doses: 2C-B (26mg), BDO (3.25 ml cumulative), Nitrous (approx 10 balloons), Phenethylamine (750 mg cumulative)]
Conclusion: While certainly a trip, this wasnt a profound or challenging experience. That was largely by design, however. Despite 26mg being the highest dose of 2CB Id tried, I expected it to be somewhat lacking in the headspace. However, this trip was pleasant and casual, just as we had intended.
I had the freedom to delve deeper briefly with the nitrous, but I didn't have to shoulder the burden of a full-blown trip.
